author: Buw
body: aight lads... having got unbanned I might as well submit to the true beauty of the Avicus competitive side. I have lead one team or even at some point two teams on OCN for more than a year now and have got a lot of experience of shotcalling and that jazz. I'm EU so will only be able to play in EU evening time on weekdays. My name is Banjo and my melee can range from God style to common randy style however I would rate myself pretty damn good with a bow ( fite me bruh ). I can play any position I think and am pretty active. I have 3 teams I may join already but ynever know when a beautiful new team can come from the horizon.
